I reviewed the diff against `SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md`'s rules (no `.github/workflows/**` touched, tier1 classification checks out — additive only, no migration/schema/auth/security-path matches, no heavy deletion).

**Verdict: reject.** The manifest/service-worker scaffolding is solid and the disclosed photo-upload gap is handled honestly, but `src/lib/offline/work-progress-queue.ts` has an undisclosed architectural flaw: the IndexedDB queue is scoped only to browser origin, not to the logged-in user/session, with no clearing on logout. Since the target persona is explicitly a field supervisor on shared/handed-off site tablets, a second user logging in before the first user's queue drains can have that data auto-synced under their own session (misattributing progress entries) or see it leak into their UI — and `syncQueuedWorkProgressEntries()` also has no guard against concurrent invocation, risking duplicate POSTs. Neither is covered by the new tests. Full reasoning and a minor retry-backoff follow-up are written to `review-verdict.json`.
